lead_raw_text:
The structure of NaMg14Ni crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P-6m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows all Mg, Na, and Ni centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors each; Mg–Mg distances range from about 3.11 to 3.36 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Na polyhedra.
